definitions.explanation: A temporary loss of consciousness, typically caused by a drop in blood pressure, shock, pain, or extreme heat. Can also be used figuratively for being overwhelmed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暑|あつ}さ→暑さ：12973_atsusa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{失神|しっしん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧{失神|しっしん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{倒|たお}れた→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧。
examples.english: She suddenly lost consciousness and collapsed.

examples.japanese: {試合中|しあいちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{失神|しっしん}し、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{救急車|きゅうきゅうしゃ}→救急車：05077_kyuukyuusha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれた→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: A player lost consciousness during the match, and an ambulance was called immediately.

notes:
Composed of {失|しつ} (lose) + {神|しん} (spirit/consciousness). Refers to a temporary loss of consciousness. Often used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to form the verb {失神|しっしん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to faint, to pass out).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {失神|しっしん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to faint, to lose consciousness
- {失神|しっしん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{倒|たお}れる→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧: to collapse unconscious
- ⟦{一時的|いちじてき}→一時的：05846_ichijiteki⟧な{失神|しっしん}: temporary fainting
- {失神|しっしん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{回復|かいふく}する→回復する：21330_kaifukusuru⟧: to recover from fainting

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{気絶|きぜつ}→気絶：19929_kizetsu⟧: fainting — very similar meaning, slightly more colloquial
- ⟦{意識|いしき}→意識：01714_ishiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}う→失う：01887_ushinau⟧: to lose consciousness — more descriptive phrase
- ⟦{卒倒|そっとう}→卒倒：23022_sottou⟧: collapsing in a faint — emphasizes the falling aspect
- ⟦{貧血|ひんけつ}→貧血：07019_hinketsu⟧: anemia — sometimes used colloquially to mean lightheadedness
